headline: FIR Against BJYM Members Over Kharge Protest
summary: Goa Police registered an FIR against BJYM members for protesting against Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge. The Congress party has dismissed the police action as a mere eyewash.

headline: BJYM Members Booked For Black-Flag Protest
summary: Goa Police booked members of the BJP Yuva Morcha for organizing a black-flag protest against Mallikarjun Kharge. The protest occurred during the Congress leader's visit to Goa.

headline: BJYM Chief Tushar Kelkar Booked by Police
summary: BJP Yuva Morcha Chief Tushar Kelkar has been booked by Goa Police over protests during Mallikarjun Kharge's visit. The case was registered following demonstrations against the Congress leader.

headline: Goa Airports See Drop In International Traffic
summary: Goa airports have recorded a steep decline in international passenger traffic. This drop comes amid a 10% overall decrease in international traffic across India.

headline: International Air Traffic In Goa Plunges
summary: Goa's international air traffic witnessed a significant plunge during the April-June quarter. The decline highlights a challenging period for international arrivals in the state.

headline: Sharp Decline In Goa's International Passengers
summary: Airports in Goa have registered a sharp drop in international passenger numbers. The decline aligns with a broader national trend of falling international air traffic.

headline: ED Arrests Two In Digital Arrest Scam
summary: The Enforcement Directorate arrested two individuals in Goa in connection with a massive digital arrest money laundering case. The investigation has uncovered an extensive banking network of over 27,850 crore rupees.

headline: Digital Arrest Scam Leads To Pan-India Network
summary: A digital arrest scam in Goa led the Enforcement Directorate to uncover a pan-India cyber fraud network that targeted 330 victims. The fraudsters allegedly swindled around 400 crore rupees.

headline: Two Arrested For Laundering Rs 2.6 Crore
summary: The Enforcement Directorate has arrested two suspects in Goa for laundering 2.6 crore rupees through a digital arrest scam. The arrests are part of a wider crackdown on cyber fraudsters.

headline: Tarun Tejpal Challenges Sentence In Supreme Court
summary: Tarun Tejpal has approached the Supreme Court to challenge his 10-year prison sentence. Meanwhile, the Goa government has questioned the maintainability of his appeal.

headline: Tejpal Must Surrender Before SC Appeal: Goa
summary: The Goa government told the Supreme Court that Tarun Tejpal must surrender and seek an exemption before his appeal is heard. The state is opposing any immediate relief without surrender.

headline: Surrender First To Challenge Conviction, SC Told
summary: Goa authorities argued in the Supreme Court that Tarun Tejpal should have surrendered before challenging his rape conviction. The state insisted on compliance with legal procedures.

headline: Cabinet Clears Strict Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved an anti-conversion bill proposing life imprisonment and heavy fines. The bill aims to strictly curb illegal religious conversions in the state.

headline: High Court Relief For Uganda-Born Senior Citizen
summary: The Bombay High Court has granted passport-related relief to a Uganda-born senior citizen residing in Goa. This decision provides significant administrative relief to the elderly resident.

headline: Anti-Conversion Bill Cleared Ahead Of Assembly
summary: The Goa Cabinet cleared the anti-conversion bill just before the upcoming legislative assembly monsoon session. The proposed law introduces strict penalties for forced conversions.

headline: Goa Celebrates Eid-e-Milad With Devotion
summary: The festival of Eid-e-Milad was celebrated across Goa with great faith and fervour. Devotees gathered in large numbers to mark the occasion with prayers and religious gatherings.

headline: Record Iron Export Clocked At Mormugao Port
summary: Mormugao Port recorded a milestone by completing the loading for the first Goa-to-US export of non-alloy pig iron. This achievement marks a significant step for the state's industrial trade.

headline: Goa RCS Trains Officials On Deemed Conveyance
summary: The Registrar of Cooperative Societies in Goa conducted a training session for officials on deemed conveyance. The initiative aims to streamline housing society property transfers.

headline: Goa Dental College Relocates To Cujira
summary: The Goa Dental College and Hospital has officially shifted its address to Cujira in Santa Cruz. Patients and visitors are advised to note the new location for medical services.

headline: IPS Officer Transferred From J&K To Goa
summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs has ordered the immediate transfer of an IPS officer from Jammu and Kashmir to Goa. The officer is expected to take up the new posting shortly.

headline: Cabinet Approves Bill To Protect Lawyers
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved a new bill aimed at curbing violence against advocates in the state. The proposed legislation seeks to ensure a safer working environment for legal practitioners.

headline: Elephant Omkar Driven Back Across Border
summary: Wildlife officials have successfully driven the wild elephant Omkar back across the border. Authorities have ruled out the use of drones to track the animal's movements.

headline: Malayalis In Goa Prepare For Onam Festivities
summary: The Malayali community in Goa is gearing up to celebrate Onam with traditional family feasts and community events. The celebrations will bring together cultural highlights and festive gatherings.

headline: Decoding India's Unique Reptile Names
summary: A look into how species are named in India reveals connections ranging from pop culture icon Jackie Chan to Goa. The report highlights the fascinating stories behind scientific nomenclature.

headline: Alankrita Sahai Praises Goa's Culture
summary: Actor Alankrita Sahai has shared her deep appreciation for the natural beauty and rich culture of Goa. She expressed her fondness for the state during a recent interaction.

headline: New Temple Darshan Circuit Launched In Goa
summary: The Goa government has launched a new eleven-temple darshan pilgrimage circuit. Senior citizens will receive a 50% concession on the pilgrimage tour.

headline: Ease Of Doing Business Bill In Assembly Next Week
summary: The Goa government is set to table a new bill aimed at improving the ease of doing business in the legislative assembly next week. The legislation seeks to simplify processes for entrepreneurs.

headline: Cabinet Approves Anti-Conversion, Business Bills
summary: The Goa cabinet has cleared key legislations, including a strict anti-conversion law and measures to protect businessmen. These bills are scheduled for presentation in the assembly.

headline: Tillari Dam Water Supply Shut For Three Months
summary: Water supply from the Tillari Dam to Goa will be completely shut down for three months due to maintenance work. Residents in affected areas are urged to use water resources prudently.

headline: Congress Questions TCP Over Rs 2,147-Cr Loss
summary: The Congress party in Goa has raised questions over an alleged revenue loss of 2,147 crore rupees in the Town and Country Planning department. The loss is reportedly linked to additional Floor Area Ratio approvals.

headline: Look-Out Circular Issued For Absconding Atala
summary: A look-out circular has been issued for drug dealer Atala, who is currently absconding in a major Goa narcotics case. Authorities are actively searching for him to face trial.

headline: HC Upholds Municipalities Ordinance, Sets Deadline
summary: The Bombay High Court has upheld the Goa Municipalities Ordinance, clearing the way for local body polls. The court has set a strict deadline of January 2 for holding the elections.

headline: HC Issues Notice To ECI Over Party Registration
summary: The High Court has issued a notice to the Election Commission of India regarding the registration of the 'Goa Congress Party'. The move follows a petition challenging the registration name.

headline: Goa To Establish First Iron Ore Testing Lab
summary: The Directorate of Mines and Geology has signed an MoU with Goa Engineering College to set up the state's first iron ore testing laboratory. This facility will expedite local mineral quality checks.

headline: Goa's Growing Forest Fire Risks Exposed
summary: A recent report highlights the increasing threat of forest and wild fires in Goa's scenic locations. Experts are urging immediate intervention to protect the state's fragile ecosystem.

headline: Kejriwal To Discuss E20 Petrol Policy In Goa
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal is scheduled to address a town hall event during his Goa visit to discuss the E20 petrol policy. The session will focus on the public concerns surrounding ethanol-blended fuel.

headline: Kawthankar Takes A Swipe At Babush Monserrate
summary: Congress leader Yatish Kawthankar took a political jibe at Minister Babush Monserrate over a controversial name change issue. He quipped that Monserrate might have to move to Kathmandu.

headline: Ensuring Safe Nightlife Tourism In Goa
summary: A feature discusses the ongoing efforts by local authorities and businesses to keep Goa's party scene safe for visitors. It highlights measures being taken to manage crowds and prevent illegal activities.

headline: The Unexpected Drivers Of Goa's Tourism Boom
summary: A detailed report explores the surprising indicators driving Goa's recent tourism growth, from villa rentals to high paneer consumption. Increased road traffic is also noted as a key metric of the boom.

headline: Maharashtra Man Arrested For Rs 42.6 Lakh Fraud
summary: A man from Maharashtra has been arrested by Goa Police for allegedly cheating a Canacona resident of 42.6 lakh rupees. The suspect was apprehended after a financial fraud complaint was filed.

headline: Fake Government Aid Scheme Cheats Goa Woman
summary: A woman in Goa was defrauded of 2.4 lakh rupees by scammers running a fake Tamil Nadu government advertisement promising financial aid of 20 lakh rupees. Police are investigating the online impersonation scam.

headline: Elephant Omkar Returns, Damages Goa Farms
summary: The wild elephant Omkar has returned to Goa and caused damage to local agricultural farms. Farmers are concerned as forestry officials monitor the situation.

headline: High Demand For Colva Police Station Jurisdiction
summary: An analysis explores why the Colva Police Station remains a highly sought-after posting for officers in Goa. The station's jurisdiction covers major tourist hubs and high-profile beach belts.

headline: FDA Seizes Unlabelled Frozen Jamun In Mapusa
summary: The Food and Drugs Administration seized a stock of unlabelled frozen jamun at the Mapusa bus stand. Officials acted on concerns over safety standards and compliance violations.

headline: AI Cameras To Detect Suspicious Number Plates
summary: Goa is planning to deploy AI-powered cameras to identify fake, altered, or suspicious vehicle license plates on roads. The system aims to enhance traffic monitoring and overall security.

headline: Over 500 Touts Booked By Calangute Police
summary: Calangute Police have registered cases against 520 touts for harassing and targeting tourists in the popular beach area. The drive is part of an ongoing effort to sanitize tourism spots.

headline: Leopard Attacks Pet Dog In Arambol
summary: A leopard climbed to the first floor of a residence in Arambol and attacked a pet dog. The incident has raised safety concerns among residents regarding wildlife encounters in residential areas.

headline: Defeat BJP To Scrap E20 Petrol: Kejriwal
summary: Arvind Kejriwal has urged voters in Goa to defeat the BJP in order to stop the rollout of E20 petrol. He claimed the policy has negative impacts on vehicle owners.

headline: SC Orders Tarun Tejpal To Surrender
summary: In a major setback for Tarun Tejpal, the Supreme Court has ordered him to surrender within three weeks. The order comes as his appeal against conviction is pending.

headline: Illegal Wine Brewing Discovered Inside Colvale Jail
summary: Following recent exposes on unauthorized food inside the Colvale Central Jail, reports have emerged of wine being illegally brewed on the premises. Authorities are investigating the security and protocol lapses.
